description: Transport statistics indicators for Kenya (20 data sets, Transport Data Commons starter data kit) is a series of data sets listed in Transport Data Commons (Transport Data Catalogue), a transport data catalogue, published or maintained by Transport for Cairo. Total number of trips by transport mode from the Nairobi City County Government, Nairobi, Kenya. Coverage: Kenya. The portal lists 20 near-identical data sets in this series (one per event, year, area or country), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher Transport for Cairo. Its tags are public transport, rail traffic, road traffic. It offers 2 resource(s) in XLSX. The portal shows 2026-07-14 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (data set page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support road network, traffic and accessibility studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-tdc-portal.
